title: Free listings for products
claims: Eligible products can appear at no media cost across Google Search, Maps, Gemini, YouTube, Shopping, Images and Lens.
Shipping and return information are important eligibility/trust inputs.

title: Prepare for the holiday season with July’s Demand Gen Drop
claims: 94% of holiday shoppers who used YouTube reported taking further steps toward purchase after watching a related video.
Checkout URLs increased Demand Gen conversions by 6% on average in Google's cited data.

title: Holiday 100: The gifts everyone’s searching for
claims: Google says Holiday 100 is based on more than 1 billion shopping-related searches per day.
2025 examples included movie projectors, kids scooters, backpack charms and crescent bags.

title: Google Shopping introduces Universal Cart, agentic shopping
claims: Google introduced Universal Cart spanning Search, Gemini, YouTube and Gmail.
Shopping flows are becoming more agentic and price/history aware.

title: Ecommerce Conversion Rate: Benchmarks & Tips (2026)
claims: Shopify cites June 2026 category conversion benchmarks: pet care 5.7%, beauty/personal care 5.32%, food/beverage 4.58%, fashion 2.77%, home/furniture 1.29%, consumer goods 1.76%, luxury/jewelry 0.63%.
Shopify cites global ecommerce benchmarks around 1.4% to 2.66% depending dataset.

title: 7 BFCM Strategies for Holiday Sales in 2026
claims: Shopify says 2025 BFCM sales by Shopify merchants totaled $14.6B, up 27% year over year.
Early customer acquisition and learning before peak are emphasized.

title: Seller Trend Report: Spring and Summer 2026
claims: Etsy reported journal charm +395%, memory journals +189%, beginner needlepoint kits +175%, Mahjong racks +228%, wall art decor +110%, gallery prints +80%.
Etsy reported bridesmaid baskets +4,200%, vintage barware +1,550%, stained-glass wedding signs +200%.
Data was based on recent Etsy search/sales activity versus prior year and was current to Feb. 10, 2026.

title: Q2 2026 Shareholder Letter
claims: Birthdays and weddings both showed double-digit year-over-year growth.
Toys and games and cultural trends such as Mahjong and custom card games showed strong year-over-year growth.
Vintage reached its strongest recent pace of growth in 1H26.

title: What are the Fees and Taxes for Selling on Etsy?
claims: Listing fee is $0.20 per listing.
Transaction fee is 6.5% of total order amount; payment processing is additional and varies by country.
Offsite Ads can add 12% or 15% on attributed orders.

title: Pinterest Predicts 2026
claims: Pinterest says 88% of its trend predictions over six years came true.
Pinterest says its trends last nearly twice as long as trends elsewhere.
Checkouts on 2025 Pinterest Predicts-related content increased 68% year over year.
2026 trends include Pen Pals, Brooched, Vamp Romantic, Glamoratti, Gimme Gummy, Mystic Outlands, Cool Blue and Cabbage Crush.

title: The 2026 festive season: Pinterest festive marketing
claims: Pinterest says 60% of users say it helps them make decisions at every stage of festive shopping.
Pinterest says holiday visual searches grew 2.3x faster than text searches year over year in the UK-facing page.
Pinterest reports average incremental ROAS of 3.71 in its cited holiday materials.

title: Holiday 2026 starts now: A Pinterest guide to success
claims: Pinterest recommends beginning holiday work before November because shoppers plan and save ideas earlier.
Pinterest says Q5 remains active: 55% of weekly users continue buying online in the week after Christmas in cited data.

title: Google Ads Benchmarks 2026
claims: Broad Search benchmark CPC for Shopping, Collectibles & Gifts is reported at $4.14.
Category CPCs vary widely, so broad Search benchmarks should not be treated as ecommerce Shopping CPCs.

title: Google Ads Benchmarks for Ecommerce: 2026 Data
claims: Agency sample reports ecommerce Search CPC $1.42, Shopping CPC $0.68, PMax CPC $0.82.
Agency sample reports Search CVR 2.8%, Shopping CVR 1.4%, PMax CVR 1.9%.
Use as directional benchmark, not universal truth.

title: Ecommerce Google Ads Benchmarks 2026
claims: Reported ecommerce benchmark: Search CPC $1.16, Shopping CPC $0.66, Search CVR 2.81%, Shopping CVR 1.91%.
Treat as directional because methodology differs from other benchmark sources.

title: Pricing
claims: No monthly fee or upfront platform fee.
Catalog products use listed base costs; digital products have a platform fee; payment processing is additional.

title: Gumroad's fees
claims: Direct/profile sales: 10% + $0.50 Gumroad fee plus payment processing.
Discover marketplace sales: 30% fee including processing.
No monthly fee.

title: Does Ko-fi take a fee?
claims: Free to join; shop items generally carry a 5% service fee under standard/free structure, plus payment processor fees.

title: Amazon Handmade
claims: Approved Handmade sellers have the ongoing monthly Professional fee waived after the first month.
Handmade referral fee is 15% or $0.30 minimum.
Custom/personalized products can be offered via Amazon Custom but must be seller-fulfilled.

title: Selling fees
claims: Up to 250 zero-insertion-fee listings per month for standard sellers, subject to terms.
Final value fees vary by category.
